about: Real recordings of farm tractors, for the Thane tractors' sounds (owner, 20 Nov 2026: real recordings over generated ones; docs/development/farming-tractor-recordings.md). Each is CC0 or plain CC BY, as its own page stated on 20 Nov 2026; the owner downloaded the Freesound originals by hand into the set's folder. Credit the CC BY ones by name and licence. The T400's voice is built from the medium ones, lowered and layered (the owner's choice), a simplification. Cuts and roles are the agent's first reading from measurements and spectrograms, for the owner to judge on the listening page; nothing here is picked.
licence: CC0 1.0 or CC BY (3.0, 4.0), per source
